articles.title: Bitcoin holds near $80,000 as oil retreats and the Fed decision looms
articles.snippet: Bitcoin was little changed near $80,400 since midnight UTC while the DeFi index was the only CoinDesk index to gain, with the Fed due to decide on Wednesday.

articles.title: Is the Internet Safe Again After the PHP Nightmare? What You Need to Know
articles.snippet: PHP shipped its fix, attackers launched millions of attempts, and governments say no one has broken in yet. Here's what that means for your passwords, your crypto, and your browsing.
